options.name: Abstinence
options.benefit: Abstain from food, drink, or another bodily indulgence chosen for the spirit.

options.name: Ceremony
options.benefit: Perform a prescribed daily ceremony honouring the channeled legend.

options.name: Prohibition
options.benefit: Avoid a behaviour or class of action opposed by the channeled spirit.

options.name: Symbol
options.benefit: Prominently display and protect a symbol associated with the spirit.
